title: Economic Uncertainty and the Beta Anomaly
authors: Zhiqi Cao; Wenfeng Wu; Youchang Wu
eligible_reason: Asset-pricing paper: portfolio sorts, Fama-MacBeth and time-series regressions of beta-anomaly returns on macro uncertainty, and fund-level panel regressions of flows/betas on lagged fund characteristics split by high/low uncertainty. No treatment adoption or DiD.
design_notes: Python (statsmodels) and Stata. CRSP/Compustat/TFN/TASS data were provided only to the Data Editor and removed from the published package; data/ holds public indices (UNC, EMU, MUI, SENT, BEX, mispricing).
data_files_note: Readme.pdf: subscription data 'only provided to Code and Data Editor ... should be removed from the publish version'.
data_provenance_note: Stock- and fund-level WRDS data not shipped; only public index series.
screener_notes: Screened from Readme.pdf and code. No DiD design.
